raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer did not effectively handle the search strategy from the beginning. Instead of narrowing down searches specific to genomic databases known to host GFF3 files (such as direct links within NCBI or Ensembl), the search queries were too broad and led to irrelevant results. This was further exacerbated by repeated unsuccessful attempts to navigate to specific results without refining the approach or shifting focus to more targeted, species-specific sections in major genomic repositories. This mirrors patterns of inadequate search refinement and misalignment with the specific content required, similar to Case #29 and Case #32.
